adjudication.rationale: In `addGuestsHandler` the DB update is committed first (`prisma.booking.update` with `attendees.createMany`), and only afterwards it performs `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` and then attempts email sending. There is no transaction/rollback around these steps, and only the email step is wrapped in a `try/catch` (calendar sync is not). So if calendar sync throws (or other later logic throws), guests remain persisted but not synced/emailed. On retry, `uniqueGuests` is computed by filtering against existing `booking.attendees`, so the same emails will result in `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and throw `BAD_REQUEST` with `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, matching the finding’s recovery/UX issue.
